claims.claim_text: Anthony J. Strobl worked at Walt Disney Studios as an in-betweener and animator from December 1938 until Army service in December 1941, making Disney his last documented civilian employer before service.
claims.evidence_excerpt: In December 1938 he began his first assignment
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The biography identifies Anthony Joseph Strobl, dates his Disney start, names film work, and says he was then drafted; the Army row independently dates entry and codes commercial artist.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the exact protected-identifier Army bridge, matching full name, Jr. variant, dated transition and matching commercial-artist occupation.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded from December 1938 to Army entry on 1941-12-05. Army service intervened before OSS, so this is not an immediate OSS affiliation.
claims.match_notes: The historical studio name is preserved. The claim is included in last-civilian-employer analytics, not immediate-affiliation analytics.

claims.temporal_assessment: The museum documents prewar work and 1941-1944 wartime service; it does not state an OSS assignment or transfer.
